**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The SVG and publisher-provided PNG preview represent one output, not two cases. SVG XML: 1024 × 1024 viewBox, 7 paths, 2 ellipses and 1 rectangle; no embedded images, external references or active content detected. Both the supplied PNG preview and a local raster rendering of the SVG were visually inspected. They differ in shape and proportions, so pixel identity is not claimed; they remain grouped as the publisher-associated vector example. The source-linked full prompt is not reproduced.
